title: Honk's Mind
description: An amazing resource pack for everyone!!
body:
WELCOME TO BRAINROT HELL Short introduction:

This resource pack is an abomination.
Not balanced. Not immersive. Not sane.

It completely obliterates vanilla Minecraft and replaces it with pure, unfiltered internet brainrot. 
If you’re looking for a “clean” or “faithful” experience — leave now, this is not the case here. You have been warned. 


You might be wondering....  💀 WHAT DOES THIS PACK DO?
                          
Everything is wrong. On purpose. This resource pack changes a massive portion of Minecraft, including:Sound effects & music (expect sudden volume spikes and auditory violence)Textures and UI elementsItems, mobs, menus, and in-game events.Nothing from your default Minecraft 1.21 experience will feel normal anymore — in singleplayer or multiplayer.

SOME MEMES INCLUDED (AND ABUSED):
This pack fuses memes from across the internet into one cursed dimension, including but not limited to:Lobotomy KaisenFormula 1 brainrotLeBron JamesPeter Griffinand many, many more...Expect unexpected replacements. 

Expect jumpscares. 

Expect regret. 

                              ⚠️WARNINGS⚠️VOLUME WARNING

– sounds may be loud, sudden, and stupid lolNot streamer-safe (is it??)
May permanently unfortunately, permanently damage your attention span just like it did to me😭 

You will forget what vanilla Minecraft felt like.

                            MY DEVELOPMENT STATUS FOR THIS PROJECTI have a life. 

Don't expect me to change it constantly. I do grind this thing like crazy. 
I did this 50% in a week. Plenty more cursed content is planned. 
Updates will continue as more textures, sounds, and ideas are added.If you have meme suggestions, bug reports, or want to contribute to the chaos, leave a comment (just like the elytra lol it is so broken).


Credits and disclaimer:

Originally inspired by Skully’s Seriously Serious Resource Pack.
Custom textures sourced from Nova Skins, Planet Minecraft, and select assets from Skully’s pack. But I've also made my own. Sounds and music sourced from myinstants.com and YouTube.This pack is non-commercial and made purely for entertainment.If there are any copyright concerns or credit issues, please leave a comment on this page, and I’ll like to reply to it.

                                   FINAL NOTE
                                  
If you’re bored of normal Minecraft… If you want chaos… If you want your game to feel wrong…Download at your own risk. Thanks, and enjoy.
